## Regenerating The Diagram

After changing `database/schema.sql` (together with its migration), run from the
repository root:

```bash
pip install -r backend/requirements.txt matplotlib   # once
python scripts/render_erd.py
```

The script reuses the SQL splitter in `backend/migrate.py`, so it needs the backend
requirements (anyone changing the schema has them for `migrate.py` anyway), plus
matplotlib. matplotlib is a documentation tool only, so it is not in
`backend/requirements.txt`.

It rewrites `db-diagram.png`, `db-diagram.mmd` and the Mermaid block above, and
running it twice changes nothing. `backend/tests/unit/test_erd_docs.py` fails when
any of them no longer matches `schema.sql`, so a schema change that skips this step
fails the quality gate and CI. The PNG carries the sha256 of `schema.sql` in its
metadata for that check.

Two things SQL cannot express are kept in the script: where each table sits in the
picture (`LAYOUT`) and the wording of each relationship (`LABELS`).
